headline: Spurs 62% favourites as market trims line
summary: Tottenham are clear favourites at 62.0% fair, with the draw at 21.1% and Coventry at 16.9%. The home price was trimmed from 64.0% to 62.0% and the handicap line moved from -1.13 to -1.03, with the sharp market moving first — a small repricing concentrated in one window rather than a reaction to news, since every named absentee was already public at 00:55. The handicap sits on -1 at 50.9%, essentially a coin flip. Goals are flat: fair total near 2.94, Over 3.0 at 48.5%, BTTS Yes at 55.9%.
